packageRules.description: Cap helm/chart-releaser-action. Original rationale was never recorded; v1.6.0 and v1.7.0 have shipped upstream. Lift once BRE confirms the cap is no longer needed.
Keep .nvmrc on a range rather than pinning it, so repos stay on the Node line they target
Runner version bumps break workflows and are easy to merge by mistake, so BRE updates them deliberately. Lift once runner bumps no longer require coordinated workflow changes.
